title: P0-5a recover-frame-seed-wire: Wire Runtime::recover to recover_runtime_frame_seed (no P2-15 dep)
description: Feature P0-5a (split from black-hat-flagged vb-pi2zl). Black-hat review round 1 found a priority inversion: P0-5 depended on P2-15 (P0 blocked on P2). This bead (P0-5a) does the frame-seed wire-up WITHOUT depending on P2-15, removing the inversion. Real source: vb_storage/src/recovery/recover.rs:251-260 (recover_runtime_frame_seed is fully implemented but orphaned — never called); vb_runtime/src/runtime/mod.rs:343-365 (Runtime::recover is gated behind #[cfg(feature = 'test-util')] and calls recover_all_incomplete_runs which returns Summary only, dropping the frame data). This bead: (1) drops the #[cfg(test-util)] gate on Runtime::recover; (2) makes Runtime::recover call recover_runtime_frame_seed for each non-terminal run; (3) reattaches the RecoveredRunAdmission to RunState.admission; (4) wires cmd_replay to call Runtime::recover + Runtime::snapshot_run to produce a ReplayReport with reconstructed RunFrame. The pending_actions coordination is split off into P0-5b. Master §68 invariants 1-5 apply. Kani harness: prove Runtime::recover is bit-identical to a live runtime at the same journal sequence. proptest: 1000 random (journal, replay) cycles produce identical reconstructed frames.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL wire Runtime::recover to call recover_runtime_frame_seed for each non-terminal run during startup
THE SYSTEM SHALL make Runtime::recover publicly callable (drop the #[cfg(test-util)] gate)

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the runtime starts and a non-terminal run is detected in the journal
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL call Runtime::recover(run_id) which calls recover_runtime_frame_seed, reattaches the RecoveredRunAdmission, and returns a reconstructed RunFrame

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user runs `vb replay <run-id> --db <path>` on a non-terminal run
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL call Runtime::recover + Runtime::snapshot_run and emit a ReplayReport containing the reconstructed RunFrame

unwanted.condition: IF the journal contains a digest mismatch (workflow, action, or policy)
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT silently default to a substituted value; it must return a typed ReplayDiverged error
unwanted.because: Master §68 invariant 4: recovery is deterministic; divergence is a hard failure
